results.question: Count customers by region.
results.response: SELECT e.customers.region, COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce.customers e GROUP BY e.region

results.question: Show total units sold per product.
results.response: SELECT p.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM ecommerce.products p JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id

results.question: Show payment totals by method.
results.response: SELECT p.method, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM ecommerce.payments p GROUP BY p.method

results.question: Find each customer's order count.
results.response: SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM ecommerce.customers c LEFT JOIN ecommerce.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id

results.question: Show average order value by region.
results.response: SELECT eecommerce.orders.region, AVG(eecommerce.payments.amount) AS avg_order_value FROM eecommerce.orders JOIN eecommerce.payments ON eecommerce.orders.order_id = eecommerce.payments.order_id GROUP BY eecommerce.orders.region

results.question: List products with their category names.
results.response: SELECT p.name, c.name AS category_name FROM ecommerce.products p JOIN ecommerce.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id

results.question: Show the five most recent orders.
results.response: SELECT * FROM ecommerce.orders WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY ordered_at DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Count orders by status.
results.response: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM ecommerce.orders GROUP BY status

results.question: Show revenue by product.
results.response: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM ecommerce.products p JOIN ecommerce.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name
